message.text:
A page.jsonl is a log: one JSON object per line, read top to bottom. Line 1 builds the page, like {"title":"Notes","icon":"description"}. Every later line is one set() call: a key that names a method calls it, and anything else is stored as data.
Three steps stay separate. {"file":"note.md"} says a file exists (the dev server writes these lines for you). {"file":"kid/page.jsonl"} also links a child page. {"place":"note.md"} draws it, in line order; .md renders as markdown, .js is imported.
Line 1 can name a class ({"class":"./Card.js"}), which is how AI 2's cards work. Put verbs like file and place on line 2 or later, since line 1 only assigns. Live demo: /framework/core/Page/jsonl/ — full rules: /framework/core/Page/doc/jsonl/
